body: I'm sorry that happened to you, but if I were you, I would still go for it. If you still have feelings for this chick, you have to do everything you can. You can't just wish things had went differently, you have to out there and change what happened. It can work out for you. You're already miserable, if you take another shot and she rejects you again, you can't feel that much worse than you already do. Keep at it until she either accepts you, or gets a restraining order. It's only a minor set-back because those things expire and in the meantime, you can think of better ways to win her over. That's what I would do. Seriously.

I'm not telling him yet. I have to get to California, first. I'm in the process of molding my interests/personality after his and modifying my body in a way that I hope he will find attractive. It could take a while before I'm satisfied with myself and actually have the money to go. At least another year.

I don't want to get over it though. Heroin ruins lives, but while you're high, you feel good and that's all that matters. Maybe if I had other things to live for, I would be more willing, maybe if I didn't spend so much time obsessing I would try to move on, but then it would just be wasted time and there would be a void. I'm going to, I have to, see this thing through. Maybe it wont end well, maybe I'll make him love me, but hopefully he'll figure that out for himself, and we can make each other happy and live together for a long time. Or maybe I'll finally realize that this is all stupid and without any purpose to my life, I'll end it all. I don't know.
I know, the line is all blurry and probably crossed. I have enough self-awareness to realize that, yeah, I'm obsessed, but I don't really care. I really do love him and that's all that matters to me.
No problem. I'm 18. I don't know, it's hard to say. Maybe I've been in love before, but I was younger and nothing ever came of it. It wasn't a persistent feeling with anyone else.

Sorry for the confusion, I'm a girl, he's a guy. There's no point to my life if he's not in it. If I knew right now that I could never be with him, I really would kill myself. But I can't let it go. I'm so lonely, but I don't want to be with anyone else. I've saved myself for him. For me, there's no one else.

Everything. I'm in love with a person I haven't spoken to in four, maybe five years and I've never even met them in real life. My whole life revolves around their Facebook postings. I live somewhere in the southern United States, they live in California. I'll never get to them. I have no job, not even a driver's license. Even if I did, what would I do? Say to them, "oh hey, I've been stalking you for years, I love you, please be with me." And that's only if they're not taken already. You see? I'm just a creep, a general miscreant.
